overview: Xu Chuyuan had secretly loved Bo Yanzhou for years. Their marriage was arranged, but all she received from him was cold indifference. When her identity as the "fake heiress" is exposed, she believes she has become nothing more than an unwanted daughter in a wealthy family and leaves in heartbreak, unaware that she is carrying twins. Unbeknownst to her, Bo Yanzhou's mother secretly takes away their baby boy, deepening the misunderstanding between them. Six years later, fate brings them together again. This time, Bo Yanzhou returns with their son, determined to win Xu Chuyuan back. When the truth finally comes to light, he fights with everything he has to reclaim the love he once lost.
title: Reclaiming My Lost Love

overview: The Five is an American news and talk show on Fox News Channel featuring a rotating panel who discuss current stories, political issues, and pop culture. The show premiered in July 2011, replacing the Glenn Beck program, and airs on weekdays at 5:00 p.m. ET with replays at 4:00 a.m. ET. On October 3, 2011, after successful ratings and high popularity, Fox News announced that The Five would become the permanent 5 p.m. series, as the program had previously been announced to last only during the summer. The Five is currently the second-most-watched program in all of cable news in the United States, placing only behind The O'Reilly Factor, also on the Fox News Channel. The program has occasionally been the number one rated cable news series in the key 25 to 54 viewing demographic.
title: The Five

overview: Twisted Yoga follows a group of young yoga students from around the world drawn to the ancient practice in search of inner peace and purpose, only to fall under the influence of reclusive Romanian "guru" Gregorian Bivolaru, the spiritual leader of an international network of yoga studios specializing in tantric rituals. As they begin to fear they've joined a cult, they discover that Bivolaru, who often summoned select female students to his Paris apartment for private initiations, has a dark past. Bivolaru now faces charges in France, including human trafficking, kidnapping and rape — allegations he denies — as these women work with French authorities to convict him.
title: Twisted Yoga
Mao Shan Zai Zai Kai Ju Shou Fu Lao Zu Zong

overview: Ki-jun, once the ace of the internal audit team, is now stuck handling petty office scandals—all thanks to his manager, In-ah. One day, he receives an anonymous tip: In-ah is involved in an inappropriate relationship at work. Digging into her secret for revenge, Ki-jun instead finds himself drawn to her.
title: Filing for Love

overview: An aspiring director hits rock bottom after 20 years chasing his debut — until he meets an overwhelmed producer who helps him rediscover his self-worth.
title: We Are All Trying Here

overview: The New Gothic redefines the legendary storytelling of the American South as it follows the collision of the enterprising Bloom family with the resurrected Mississippi Mafia. Set in a landscape stained by red clay and bad blood, villainy is commonplace. But power is singular.
title: The New Gothic

overview: 12 негритят is a show about people, a project that the characters themselves make. 12 people learn to live together, make friends, fall in love, quarrel and make up, build relationships.
title: 12 негритят

overview: Yom and Wok compete for a girl's attention but she is more interested in Pentor. They become angry and plot a vengeful plan to get even.
title: Pen Tor 2017

overview: Pen Tor is about modern working singles who are looking for partners. It is centered around Mr. Pentor, a businessman in the BKL company. He wants to have an easy life and just wants to be a normal businessman like other people in Bangkok.
title: Pen Tor 2018

overview: Special Report with Bret Baier (formerly Special Report with Brit Hume) is an American television news and political commentary program appearing on Fox News Channel, currently hosted by Bret Baier. It airs live each Monday through Friday at 6:00 PM ET. The show focuses on both reporting and analysis of the day's events, with a primary focus on national political news. The show has been a part of the Fox News program lineup since 1998 and is the number one cable news broadcast in its time slot.
title: Special Report

overview: A young lawyer with an extraordinary memory confronts the hurdles of proving his father's innocence in the face of serious criminal accusations.
title: Remember

overview: Q, the god of love who lost confidence in love, asked to leave heaven and go to the human world to find the "answer to love". In such an era where it is easy to love and break up, when he met Design, Q finally changed his opinion about love, which he had firmly believed in for 200 years.
title: The Messenger

overview: A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.
title: My Royal Nemesis

overview: Ryou and Zen are two men who hate to lose—especially to each other. From high school rivals to rival co-workers, these two men have always been locked in fierce competition. They've competed over grades, sports, and even the number of Valentine's chocolates received! And now that they're salesmen at the same company, their rivalry has reignited. One night, while out for drinks, the two begin arguing about who's more experienced in love. Suddenly, their newest competition is set: the winner is whoever makes the other fall in love with them first! But will this competition of hearts really lead to a win or something far more complicated?
title: Fake Fact Lips

overview: In Alexander, as the Athenian empire crumbles, the world's greatest mind, Aristotle, arrives in Macedonia to tutor a volatile young prince Alexander. Amid palace intrigue, forbidden love, brutal war and ruthless ambitions, their unlikely friendship shapes an empire and alters the course of history.
title: Alexander

overview: Lawyer Lorenzo Ligas is the man everyone would like to be. He is fired from his prestigious law firm because he is unable to distinguish between duty and pleasure, and to get back to the top he will face a challenge that he cannot tackle alone.
title: Avvocato Ligas

overview: Set in Boston, The Practice centers on a firm of passionate attorneys to whom every case is important and every client worth a fight to the end. Pursuing justice, however, sometimes means crossing the line...
title: The Practice

overview: Anderson Cooper 360° (commonly shortened to either AC-360 or 360) is a television news show on CNN, hosted by the American journalist Anderson Cooper. The program covers a number of news stories of the day, usually through live or taped reports from the network's correspondents. The coverage can also include analysis from experts on the issues, commonly featured in or after the taped reports.
title: Anderson Cooper 360°

overview: With a vivid and lively gallery of characters, this drama unfolds four warm and healing stories set in xizang. There is a vibrant xizang's grandma, a xizang's cuisine team stepping onto the global stage, an indomitable young plateau marathon runner, and a brave and pure blind girl. They meet and illuminate each other atop the plateau, just as a line from the drama goes: "In the scenery we pass by, lie the lives of others; encounters from afar are also a reunion after a long separation."
title: The Galloping Heart

overview: Jiang Ruoli, the legitimate daughter of the Prime Minister's mansion, has the gift of precognition. When she dreams that her parents will be killed on the Lantern Festival, she tries to change their fate, only to be drawn into a dark conspiracy. She then meets Huo Linchuan, the heir to the Duke's mansion, who hides the mystery of ten lifetimes of reincarnation. Using his memories from past lives, Huo Linchuan saves Jiang Ruoli many times. Starting as allies, the two slowly fall in love. Through family power struggles, tangled secrets, and misunderstandings, they stand together against the hidden villain. Transcending cycles of reincarnation, they finally break the curse and stay by each other's side for eternity.
title: Reincarnated Love

overview: Great British Castle Rescue follows Rick Edwards as he ventures inside some of the UK's most spectacular and endangered castles. From crumbling medieval towers to collapsing royal chambers, engineers and historians battle to stabilise these epic structures with help from National Lottery funding. Each rescue unlocks extraordinary stories of warrior kings, civil wars, brutal betrayals and forgotten lives. Across each episode, Rick meets heritage experts, engineers and stonemasons racing to save these buildings. Blending cutting-edge engineering, adventure and vivid historical reconstruction, the series reveals how these fortresses shaped Britain, and whether they can survive for future generations. Castles featured are Fyvie, Gwyrch and Lowther.
title: Great British Castle Rescue

overview: Luz lives a modest life with her daughter Catalina, who is ashamed of her humble origins and pretends to be wealthy while dreaming of a life of luxury. Miguel Ángel, a successful blind lawyer, struggles to earn the approval of his powerful father, the owner of the prestigious Arango-Nova vineyards. Years ago, a scandal at the estate tore Luz and Miguel Ángel apart, cutting short a love that never truly faded. An unexpected reunion forces Luz to return to the vineyards with Catalina, reopening old wounds and bringing long-buried secrets to light. As Luz confronts lingering feelings, Catalina, blinded by ambition, pushes herself to dangerous extremes. Amid betrayal and sacrifice, mother and daughter become entangled in a battle where love and ambition put everything at risk.
title: Corazón de Oro

overview: Creators, special guests and stars — including Cillian Murphy — unpack the "Peaky Blinders" saga in this official companion podcast for the new film.
title: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man Podcast

overview: In Monster Aliens, chilling encounters blur the line between UFO sightings and legendary beasts. From Bigfoot to owl-men, witnesses and experts uncover a global pattern that suggests monsters and extra-terrestrials may be one terrifying mystery.
title: Monster Aliens

overview: Rita Galich, a housing lawyer, works at a social center. One day, she receives the news that her father, a respected lawyer and university lecturer Evgeny Vladimirovich, is accused of murdering his graduate student. Evgeny Vladimirovich's guilt is obvious to everyone — he was detained at the scene of the crime, his fingerprints were found on the murder weapon and on the victim's body. But Rita does not believe that her father was involved in what happened, and wants to find out the truth on her own.
title: Мёртвая точка

overview: Erin Burnett OutFront is an hour-long television news program hosted by Erin Burnett on CNN. The show premiered on October 3, 2011 in the 7PM and 11PM time slot to replace John King, USA. CNN said in 2011 they hoped Burnett's expected popularity would provide an "attractive" opening to an evening of "talk shows and news analysis". Erin Burnett, OutFront is broadcast live from CNN's Time Warner Center studios in New York City or on location from the site of a breaking news event, airing from 7:00 pm ET to 8:00 pm ET and also airs via tape-delay on CNN Philippines every Tuesday-Friday at 5:00 pm local time since March 17, 2015. The program covers a number of news stories of the day in a Count-up format, starting at #1 – most important and making it to #7 by the end of the hour. Burnett's program features taped packages from CNN Correspondents along with analysis and panel discussion.
title: Erin Burnett OutFront

overview: New variety show presented by comedy duo Hale and Pace. Weekly items include well-known names battling it out in Celebrity Quiz, unlikely impersonations of famous musical acts in Stars with Smoke in Their Eyes, and a search for Britain's most generous towns.
title: h&p@bbc.

overview: Skateboarder Madars Apse travels the world to skate with and learn from people pushing the culture of skateboarding in their own special way.
title: Skate Tales

overview: Follow Australia's favourite portaloo plumber and part-time philosopher on a sight seeing tour you won't find in any travel guide
title: Kenny's World

overview: The Bob Morrison Show is the story of an ordinary family from through the eyes of their pet dog, Bob Morrison. Bob is an adorable stray that is welcomed by the youngest member of the Morrison clan, Ben, but he has a tough time winning over the rest of the family.
title: The Bob Morrison Show

overview: When Mike, a bankrupt landlord, and his adolescent daughter Chloe suddenly find themselves homeless, they decide the only solution is to move in with their three tenants. But father and daughter are shocked to learn that they now share a house with three people with an intellectual disability, and a motorbike-mad social educator. And if Chloe has something to say about the situation, so do Robert, Trev, Belinda and Jack. A warring comedy of foiled expectations follows.
title: House Gang

overview: Taku Chiga (An Togashi), a first-year high school student living in Nasu Town, Tochigi Prefecture, one day happens to witness a young man, Mitsuru Morimoto (Mirai Fukahori), about to jump off a bridge and instinctively stops him. When Taku talks to Mitsuru after he regains his senses, it seems Mitsuru has nowhere to go and no money. Though suspicious, Taku couldn't bring himself to think Mitsuru was a bad person and reluctantly allowed him to stay for just one night. However, it later transpires that Mitsuru was the best friend of Suga's late elder brother, Harumi (Yoshida Haruto). Why has his brother's friend appeared now? What is his true identity? And what is the secret behind the sketchbook clutched in Mitsuru's hand—?
title: Shinda Ani no Shinyuu wo Hiroimashita

overview: A legend spreads on Xingpu Islet: toss a stone into the sea, and your wish may come true. He Xiangyong, a young man beaten down by life, makes a desperate wish to disappear. The next day, he wakes as Zhong Xiaoyou. No one knows him except his best friend Wanzhe, who stays by his side. Little by little, his new life brings warmth. He reconnects with his father, with everyone. Then Haowei returns, haunted by his own wounds. He's an old friend, a secret crush, and he can't explain why Xiaoyou feels so familiar. Meanwhile, Wanzhe wishes for epic love under shooting stars, sparking a chase by fisher Xiaohai. But Wanzhe is torn between sweet gestures and unsure feelings.As feelings deepen, Haowei and Xiaoyou's relationship grows painful, strained by their secret. Wanzhe and Xiaohai's bond is torn between true feelings and a mere wish. When shooting stars return, truths surface, confessions wait, and choices press in. Everyone must pay the price: memories fade, identities slip, love hangs in the balance. In the end, they face one final choice: hold onto the miracle, or let it go. Fate is waiting.
title: Wishing Upon the Shooting Stars

overview: Predator Files takes viewers onto the front lines of the fight to apprehend the world's most dangerous online child predators. Led by Roo Powell, law-enforcement consultant, survivor advocate, and founder of SOSA (Safe From Online Sexual Abuse), the series documents high-stakes undercover operations conducted in direct partnership with ICAC task forces, vice units, and district attorneys across the United States.
title: Predator Files

overview: When six gay strippers at a Florida gay strip club are asked to live together, tensions boil as they navigate interpersonal conflicts and struggles in the industry.
title: Stripped Down

overview: The Situation Room with Wolf Blitzer and Pamela Brown: The command center for breaking news, politics and extraordinary reports from around the world.
title: The Situation Room

overview: Bear Grylls Is Running Wild follows legendary adventurer Bear Grylls as he takes some of the most famous people on the planet into the wild for a 48-hour journey of a lifetime. With thrilling action and revealing conversations, Bear takes his guests on unforgettable adventures in breath-taking wilderness and reveals a side of some of your favorite people like you've never seen before. This season, Bear Grylls leads cast members on a globe-spanning adventure through some of the planet's most unforgiving landscapes — from Norway's glacial wilderness to the legendary mountains of Eryri in Wales. The journeys cut through Arctic rainforest, vast canyonlands, and brutal desert terrain, pushing participants to their limits with glacier crossings, canyon descents, high-risk extractions, and an adrenaline-charged freefall from 11,000 feet, into an adventure along the Irish Sea.
title: Bear Grylls Is Running Wild

overview: Mean, moody, miserable and magnificently funny, Jack Dee takes to the stage at the Bohemia Club with an assortment of music guests.
title: The Jack Dee Show

overview: Dive into the 125 years of aviation to uncover how aircraft have reshaped our world. The series explores the engineering secrets behind its success, its humble origins, and what made these aircraft icons years after their initial success.
title: Planes That Changed History

overview: Jerónimo Ponce III, regional manager of Olimpo Soaps, is a nightmare for his employees, who must endure his politically incorrect outbursts just to survive the workday.
title: La Oficina

overview: When her husband drops the bombshell that he wants a divorce, Mira sets out to rebuild her life on her own terms.
title: Mira: Her Şey Yolundaymış Gibi

overview: Teen Kids News (initially titled EKN Worldwide Kids News and alternately abbreviated on-air as TKN since 2012) is an educational newsmagazine series aimed at children between the ages of 13–16 years old and their parents that debuted in first-run syndication the weekend of September 27, 2003. Teen Kids News discusses important issues in a format intended to educate and inform both children and adults. In-studio segments are shot at studios in Manhattan with field reports done on location around the country and world. The series meets Federal Communications Commission guidelines for educational and informational programming. U.S. television stations are required by law to broadcast three hours of children's programming each week; the majority of affiliates that run the series typically air it on Saturday or Sunday mornings depending on the station, though a few air the series on Fridays in the morning or daytime time periods. The series airs on over 200 TV stations covering approximately 91% of the country and is seen in 1,000 locations in 175 countries worldwide through the American Forces Network and is seen in 12,600 schools through a special classroom education feed. Although the TV Parental Guidelines do not require news programs to receive a rating, all episodes of the series are rated TV-PG. Beginning with the tenth season premiere on the weekend of September 15, 2012, Teen Kids News began broadcasting in high-definition. In-studio segments are broadcast in the format, though most field reports continue to be produced and aired in 4:3 standard definition, with pillarboxing added to fill the left and right sides ofwidescreen television sets.
title: Teen Kids News

overview: Power Couple Romania is a reality TV competition that tests the resilience, trust and physical limits of celebrity couples.
title: Power Couple România – La bine şi la greu

overview: A project about fashion, style, and beauty with Alexey Sukharev! Using Russian and Western showbiz stars as examples, we highlight five fashion trends of the season. We'll show you all the successful and unsuccessful examples of how celebrities have embraced these trends, with a fashion expert commenting on them. We'll also tell you what to bring back from your mom's or grandma's closet to stay on trend. And in our columns, you'll learn how much Russian stars' looks cost and how their style has evolved over the years.
title: Без кутюр

overview: When upper class English girl Penelope Townes finds a magic opal that contains two Australian genies, Bruce and his son Baz, she thinks all her problems are over. Bruce, however, has other ideas.
title: The Genie From Down Under

overview: Kima loses her job and pursues a crazy idea. Nawal struggles with her desire to have children. Alex thinks the Flemish have it too easy. Three friends from Borgerhout search for happiness and stumble through life happily.
title: BOHO

overview: Agent from Above follows Han Chieh, a spirit medium bound to serve the Third Crown Prince to atone for a childhood mistake by resolving supernatural disturbances in the human world. Along the way, he meets the optimistic college student Yeh Tzu and detective Chang Min, who can see spirits. Together, they face deadly confrontations with the mysterious and ruthless villain Chen Chi-sha, while uncovering the truth behind Chen Wu Tien-chi, a being threatening the balance between the human and demon realms — leading Han Chieh to rediscover his purpose and the true meaning of his gift.
title: Agent from Above

overview: Newsnight is the BBC's flagship news programme and runs on BBC2 five nights a week. Its format, with a limited number of items covered in each show, allows an in-depth analytical approach to news stories, with a particular emphasis on political and economic affairs. The show largely eschews the "human-interest" stories favoured by many news programmes.
title: Newsnight

overview: The Race for Ancient Egypt in Colour reveals the extraordinary story of Egypt in the years between the World Wars – a time when archaeology became entangled in the politics of a nation striving for sovereignty. In 1922, Egyptology burst onto the world stage with Howard Carter's discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb sparking global Egyptomania. But the discovery came amid a period of rapid political change, with Egypt having won partial independence from Britain. As its leaders sought greater control over foreign excavations, many Western archaeologists resisted, unwilling to relinquish access to a past, and despite the crucial Egyptian contributions that went largely unrecognised, the race for ancient Egypt was on! The series also addresses other key discoveries made during this era such as Queen Hetepheres' tomb, and Pierre Montet's spectacular yet little-know discovery at Tanis – until World War II brought this golden age of discovery in Egypt to an end.
title: The Race for Ancient Egypt in Colour

overview: Semi-unemployed, semi-divorced, semi-happy, but above all an unsuccessful lawyer. More psychologist than lawyer, Vincenzo Malinconico always has an off-topic thought in his head. He mostly defends friends and relatives in not particularly demanding disputes that he doesn't always win. Separated, with two children, women like him due to his insecurity, but he is unable to fulfill himself on a sentimental level. Vincenzo Malinconico makes us passionate about his ramshackle events and shows the world through his ironic and authentic gaze.
title: Vincenzo Malinconico, avvocato d'insuccesso

overview: The crime-fighting canine joins his partner, Detective Max Steiner, to solve even the hardest cases in the Austrian capital.
title: Rex - Vienna Calling

overview: In the 60s, the Government encourages Islanders to leave the French West Indies to escape poverty that results from the closure of sugar mills. Lured by the idea of a "dream country", they find life in Europe is not what they had imagined.
title: Le Rêve français

overview: Iliza Shlesinger and her chef husband Noah Galuten travel the length of New Zealand discovering all of the sights, tastes and smells the country has to offer in preparation for Iliza's first New Zealand comedy show.
title: This Tastes Funny

overview: Vet paramedics race to save critically ill pets at home and on the road. Join Melbourne's vet paramedics for real pet emergencies.
title: Ready Vet Go: The Vet Paramedics

overview: Unacceptable features Ed Gamble as host with two teams of comics battling to convince a studio audience of their most daft, niche, unwise or unacceptable views that they and their teammates must then defend. Joined by some of the biggest names in comedy each week, Unacceptable will see a live "swingometer" track how many audience members the teams win over with their wit and punchlines as they aim to convince the crowd, with Gamble introducing a series of challenges to force them to practice what they preach.
title: Unacceptable

overview: In a sounding Trøndelag, the businessman has been hunting down Norwegian waterworks, ports and properties. We uncover Norwegian security holes and seek him out with a hidden camera.
title: Hva gjorde denne russeren i Norge?

overview: Twenty years ago, a child was secretly switched. The Mu family's true young master, Shen Jibai, was cast out and grew up among ordinary people, living a poor and dangerous life. The false heiress, Mu Zhiyu, returns to the country as a top auctioneer, determined to take back the auction house from her stepmother, Xu Mingzhu. Xu Mingzhu uses Shen Jibai to approach Mu Zhiyu, drawing the two of them into a vortex of power struggles. As they pull against each other within the schemes of the powerful family, they eventually join forces to seek revenge.
title: Wild & Fiery

overview: Chinese policeman Desheng is a hereditary officer of the law and a member of the Communist Party, who grew up respecting rules and protocols. They taught him everything: to fight, shoot, negotiate, but he never had a chance to apply the skills: there is perfect order in his neighborhood. But he has learned Russian well and understands our culture. So the hero gets to partner up with the metropolitan Coast. Kostya's personal file says that he knows Chinese, although this is not the case. It was a joke, which was why Desheng was assigned to him. Kostya himself knows only a couple of phrases and hieroglyphs from Hong Kong action movies, which his father raised him on. Therefore, he easily distinguishes Chow Yun Fat from Jackie Chan, understands weapons and wears sunglasses. The real service turned out to be more boring than the movies, but Kostya is still trying to add more action to the routine.
title: Полицейский по обмену

overview: Mad Money is an American finance television program hosted by Jim Cramer that began airing on CNBC on March 14, 2005. Its main focus is investment and speculation, particularly in publicly traded stocks. In a notable departure from the CNBC programming style prior to its arrival, Mad Money presents itself in an entertainment-style format rather than a news broadcasting one. Cramer defines "mad money" as the money one "can use to invest in stocks ... not retirement money, which you want in 401K or an IRA, a savings account, bonds, or the most conservative of dividend-paying stocks." Mad Money replaced Dylan Ratigan's Bullseye for the 6 p.m. Eastern Time slot. On January 8, 2007, CNBC began airing reruns of the show at 11 p.m. Eastern Time, on Monday through Friday, and at 4 a.m. Eastern Time, on Saturdays. In March 2012, the program became a part of what was formerly branded as NBC All Night in the nominal 3:07 a.m. ET/2:07 a.m. timeslot on weeknights, replacing week-delayed repeats of NBC's late night talk shows. In that form, only the video for the program was presented on a 16:9 screen with gray branded windowboxing andpillarboxing, with all enhanced business information, including the CNBC Ticker, removed. Because of the scheduling of local station's 4 a.m. or 4:30 a.m. newscasts to airEarly Today depending on how a station schedules its overnight programming (even if it airs at the regular time in the Eastern and Pacific time zones for instance, seven minutes would have to be cut-off to fit in Early Today and a local newscast starting at 4:30 a.m.), it is subject to local pre-emption, including by NBC O&O's. On August 4, 2014, Mad Money was first broadcast in full 1080i HD, resulting in the removal of the sidebar that was seen on all of CNBC's other trading-day programming, until the sidebar itself was permanently removed altogether on October 13, 2014. The NBC presentation displays the native widescreen HD picture, albeit with the CNBC Ticker space still filled in with gray windowboxing.
title: Mad Money

overview: Secret Sex Lives of Tyrants uncovers the private worlds of some of history's most notorious dictators. The series examines the sexual power plays, obsessions and abuses that influenced rulers' reigns - and sometimes the fate of nations. From Muammar Gaddafi's secret sex chambers, Fidel Castro's insatiable womanising, Joseph Goebbels' politically charged affairs, Saddam Hussein's sexual brutality, Mao Zedong's concubine network and Idi Amin's murderous polygamy, the series reveals how intimate appetites became deliberate instruments of control.
title: Secret Sex Lives of Tyrants

overview: Explores six different aspects of Adolf Hitler's life and reign, revealing how an uneducated, ordinary man left a legacy of unprecedented evil.
title: Adolf Hitler: Decoding a Dictator

overview: In Lex, when a disgraced former reality star accidentally films a murder in the background of a $20 Cameo video, he finds himself at the center of a global conspiracy — and on the run from powerful forces who want him dead. Using the skills he acquired navigating reality TV's toxic social dynamics, Lex must fight to not get killed, to expose the truth, and most importantly… to get back on TV.
title: Lex

overview: Durango follows Mikey, a ski bum townie chasing a buzz, and Bunny, a homeschooled runaway working as a greasy-spoon waitress. Together they're riding an avalanche of bad decisions and falling in love while running from cops, criminals, and Mikey's wife in pursuit of their own American dream.
title: Durango

overview: First Timers on the Frontline follows student, intern and newly qualified paramedics as they face real emergencies. The series offers a close look at a new generation of paramedics learning on the job with support from advanced paramedics and senior members of the National Ambulance Service.
title: First Timers on the Frontline

overview: Emma Harte has trained her grand-daughter, Paula, to 'hold the dream' and retain intact the vast business empire that is her legacy from Emma. But will the burden prove too heavy?
title: Hold the Dream

overview: Paula feuds with her cousins as she fights to save her grandmother Emma's business.
title: To Be the Best

overview: Britain's best young spellers battle it out in five regional heats, but only one person can go through each day to the final where they will compete for the title of Hard Spell champion.
title: Hard Spell

overview: Lucca, 1942. After an act of desperate defiance, Margherita is committed to Maggiano by her husband. Here she meets Mario Tobino, a doctor returning from the front who opposes the coercive methods of the institution. While he rediscovers his old love Paola, now a partisan and persecuted, Mario seeks the truth about Margherita: is she really ill or just a victim of violence?
title: Le Libere Donne

overview: All the smoke, all the speed, and all the style!! Drift This is comin' in sideways as Chris Forsberg and Ryan Tuerck take five from their pro cars to bring some variety to the drift game. These two legends of drift pull out all the stops to go full drift in big ol' trucks, teeny li'l cars, things that should never drift, and everything that should have been drifting all along!
title: Drift This

overview: Rachael Ray, also known as Rachael and The Rachael Ray Show, is an American talk show starring Rachael Ray that debuted in syndication in the United States and Canada on September 18, 2006 and also airs in other countries. It is taped at Chelsea Television Studios in New York City. The show's 8th season premiered on September 9, 2013, and became the last Harpo show in syndication to switch to HD with a revamped studio. The concept behind this program showcases Ray's culinary skills. She brings various celebrities on screen to discuss their accomplishments in the entertainment, sports, and media industries. Ray asks for tips and strategies for staying healthy and safe from various health and lifestyle experts, she includes make-over segments, and features musical performances, all of which are features along the same lines of The Oprah Winfrey Show. She does, however, keep cooking in the forefront by including at least one cooking segment at the end of each episode, and sometimes inviting her celebrity guests to join her in the kitchen. According to Ray, "People know me for my love of food, but I have so much more I want to share". The set has the audience seated on a large turntable that rotates so that the audience can always see the "action" on the circular stage that surrounds them. At the end of each show, with the exception of a few more guests after Ray's cooking segments, Ray's tagline is, "We'll see you when we see you".
title: Rachael Ray

overview: Day One follows the story of Ulises Albet, a computer prodigy who left Barcelona and the world of technology after the death of his younger sister. Ten years later, a mysterious call from his former partner and best friend, Samuel Barrera, forces him to return during the Mobile World Congress. Samuel warns him that the world is in danger, leading Ulises to confront his past, technological advances, and the fundamental question: how far can we go without losing what makes us human?
title: Day One

overview: The Sisaundra Show is a live daily talk show blending celebrity interviews, musical performances, faith-driven and inspirational conversations designed to uplift, inform and entertain while celebrating Black culture.
title: The Sisaundra Show

overview: Point of View (POV) is a live panel talk show centered on the perspectives and lived experiences of diverse Black women, delivering timely discussions on current events, relationships, career, wellness and issues shaping Black communities nationwide.
title: Point of View (POV)

overview: From the hottest supercars to everyday rides, this series covers everything from track tests to epic road trips to car-of-the-year showdowns.
title: EVO

overview: When legends take the field and a nation dares to dream, history is made. Lace up your soccer shoes: Pelé and his all-star team are coming for the cup.
title: Brasil 70: A Saga do Tri

overview: Best in Chow is hosted by Cris Nannarone, a veteran road warrior and standup comedian, scours restaurants, diners, food trucks and everything in between, to find the best burger, pizza or taco.
